description: This file implements a heap stress testing utility for Zephyr OS, including functions for random allocation and freeing of memory blocks, and a core function 'sys_heap_stress' to perform heap stress tests with customizable alloc/free functions.

methods.name: rand32
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random 32-bit number using a linear congruential generator for cross-platform test repeatability.

methods.name: rand_alloc_choice
methods.description: Decides whether to allocate or free memory based on current heap usage and target percentage.

methods.name: rand_alloc_size
methods.description: Determines a random block size to allocate, favoring smaller sizes logarithmically.

methods.name: rand_free_choice
methods.description: Selects a random allocated block to free.

methods.name: sys_heap_stress
methods.description: Performs a heap stress test by repeatedly allocating and freeing memory blocks using provided function pointers, tracking statistics.
